requestDescription.pid: Scan the QR code with the wallet to open the iGrant verification request and start transferring PID data back to the verifier.
requestDescription.poa: Scan the QR code with the wallet to open the iGrant verification request and start transferring PoA data back to the verifier.
requestDescription.eucc: Scan the QR code with the company wallet to open the iGrant verification request and start transferring EUCC data back to the verifier.

heroIntro.pid: Request a normalized PID record from the personal wallet. This step simulates identifying the user in the service.
heroIntro.poa: Request normalized power-of-attorney evidence from the personal wallet. This simulates retrieving proof of mandate from the user so that the company-side transactions can begin.
heroIntro.eucc: Request normalized organization evidence from the company wallet. This simulates receiving the EUCC from the company to verify the company in question.
heroIntro.review: Review the collected data and confirm that the matched VAT attestation is the right one for issuance.
heroIntro.vatIssuance: Submit the VAT attestation issuance request and follow how the normalized issuance result progresses.

workflowStep.heroSecondaryIntro: This simulates the review phase, where the collected data is used to match against the known VAT attestations that can be issued. Currently only the test data matches an attestation.
workflowStep.currentStepFailed: The current step failed in the normalized session state. Retry the action from this step card when ready.

review.matchedHint: Matched from the verified EUCC company before issuance.
review.automaticHint: The review payload appears automatically after PID, PoA, and EUCC succeed.

sessionSection.title: Prepare local workflow session
sessionSection.copy: Select the local vendor profile and review the available session state before the step-by-step flow is connected to live actions.

testCredentialCopy.externalWallets: This vendor creates real wallet offers for seeded test credentials. Use the QR code below when the PID issuer connection appears.
testCredentialCopy.localWallets: This vendor supports local mock credential seeding, so wallets can be preloaded before running vendor-backed steps.
testCredentialCopy.noWalletSeeding: This vendor does not expose local mock credential seeding. Credential state must come back through vendor adapter actions.

sessionSection.pidIssuerDescription: Use this QR code or deep-link to open the wallet and accept the PID credential offer from the issuer.
sessionSection.reviewPayloadSummary: Assemble PID, company, PoA, and EUCC into one review object.
sessionSection.reviewPayloadEmpty: The review payload appears automatically after PID, PoA, and EUCC succeed. This card becomes the explicit submission surface for VAT issuance.
sessionSection.issuanceResultSummary: VAT issuance output appears here after submission. Pending vendor modes can remain in progress until a later status refresh.
sessionSection.issuanceResultEmpty: VAT issuance output appears here after the explicit submit action. Pending vendor modes can stay in progress until a later status refresh.
sessionSection.sessionOverviewCopy1: The landing page now keeps vendor selection, service status, and test credential setup in one place, with the active session ID visible directly in the status block.
sessionSection.sessionOverviewCopy2: The mock local vendor now runs directly from the page with success and failure simulation modes for every step.

pid.title: PID collection surface
pid.copy: This page focuses on collecting personal identity evidence from the personal wallet before downstream steps become available.

poa.title: PoA collection surface
poa.copy: This page focuses on power-of-attorney evidence and keeps PID availability visible as upstream context.

eucc.title: EUCC collection surface
eucc.copy: This page focuses on organisation evidence from the company wallet and shows the prerequisite identity state alongside it.
